_README: Illustrative synthetic response frequencies generated by Q-Cog itself. They are NOT the original published values; see data/README.md.

question_order_illustrative.name: Two-question order design (illustrative, synthetic)
question_order_illustrative.provenance: Cohorts of 400 simulated participants per question order, drawn from the Q-Cog question-order model at the recorded parameters with a fixed seed, shaped after the qualitative pattern reported in Wang & Busemeyer (2013) and Moore (2002). NOT the original published values.

conjunction_illustrative.name: Linda conjunction design (illustrative, synthetic)
conjunction_illustrative.provenance: Evaluated with the Q-Cog conjunction model at the stated parameters, shaped after the qualitative pattern reported in Tversky & Kahneman (1983) and modelled in Busemeyer et al. (2011). NOT the original published values.
